feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: iteration 1 (score 75.97, best so far) had kp 2.0, kd 0.2 and base_speed 1.4. Its max_error was 0.061 to 0.065 on every track, s-bend line losses were 1.95, slalom line losses were 2.0, and steering_oscillation was 0.23 on the s-bend and 0.14 on the slalom. Iteration 2 (score 50.60) cut base_speed to 1.2 and kd to 0.1. Progress fell (s-bend 0.29 to 0.155, oval 0.16 to 0.10), max_error did not improve, and oscillation dropped (s-bend 0.14). So lower speed cost progress without moving the failure point, and lower kd reduced jitter. This candidate restores base_speed to 1.4 and keeps kd at 0.1, so it should recover iteration 1's progress with less jitter. kp rises from 2.0 to 2.5 as one modest step, aimed at max_error, which has stayed near 0.061 to 0.065 in every race so far. It is a targeted, valid change within the contract limits, and the sensor, weight, ki and line_loss settings are unchanged, so the kp effect can be read directly. Next-race rules: if steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15 with kp 2.5, lower kd to 0.05 rather than adding more kp, because iteration 1 linked kd 0.2 to oscillation of 0.23. If progress is near iteration 1 but max_error still sits at about 0.06 with line losses unchanged, the next step is a larger kp or a sensor-geometry change, not more speed. If progress falls below iteration 1 levels with max_error unchanged, return base_speed to about 1.3. Keep ki at 0 unless rms_error shows a steady offset. Approving to race: this is the best-supported next step, and racing it gives the telemetry needed to judge kp directly.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.15 on the s-bend or slalom with kp 2.5, lower kd from 0.1 to 0.05 in one step (iteration 1 showed kd 0.2 coincided with oscillation of 0.23).

If max_error stays near 0.06 and line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom stay near 2 with kp 2.5, try a larger kp step (for example 3.0) or a different sensor spacing, rather than more base_speed (iteration 2 showed lower speed cost progress without moving the failure point).
If progress falls below iteration 1 levels (s-bend 0.29, oval 0.16) with max_error unchanged, return base_speed to about 1.3 and keep kd at 0.1.
